dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me a bit about yourself...

dialogues.speaker: Tieshan
dialogues.text: My name is Tieshan. I'm a member of the Millelith, and I work to defend Liyue Harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Tieshan
dialogues.text: Well, actually, I'm not from the city. Qingxu Pool's where my home is, thereabouts.

dialogues.speaker: Tieshan
dialogues.text: Perhaps Rex Lapis has smiled upon my dutiful service, because after I heard the last round of divine predictions at the Rite of Descension...

dialogues.speaker: Tieshan
dialogues.text: ...I tried helping my family to do some business on the side, and what do you know — we actually had some small success.

dialogues.speaker: Tieshan
dialogues.text: Recently, I've moved my family property to Chihu Rock, so I suppose I do count as a citizen of Liyue Harbor now. *chuckles*
